subject: english
stem: You need to leave after meeting someone. Which ending is least abrupt?
options: I will disappear now because you need to catch my bus.
It was nice meeting you, but you must leave for my bus.
I have to catch my bus. It was nice meeting you.
I have to catch my bus, so our meeting was not useful.

optionRationales.reason: 說話者應說自己要離開，不能命令對方為自己的公車離開。
I have to catch my bus. It was nice meeting you.：先給離開理由，再禮貌收束。
有離開理由，卻用負面評價否定整次會面，不是自然友善的收束。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「以招呼、介紹、回應、追問與收束的功能鏈安排輪次，並讓每一輪承接前一輪的新資訊。」可推出 I have to catch my bus. It was nice meeting you.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 I have to catch my bus. It was nice meeting you. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
